o: In season 5, now that alien mission partners Terry and Korvo are married, the whole Solar Opposites team are focused on family values.

eps.o: The Solars try getting approved for permanent residency on their new home planet: Clervix 3.
Korvo and Terry celebrate their honeymoon.

eps.t: Live Die Repeat Device (Formerly known as the Edge of Tomorrow Device)
eps.o: Korvo uses a device to keep reliving the same day, so he can impress a guy who works at the hardware store.
Terry and Korvo open a private school.
Jesse's ex-boyfriends come back to haunt the Solars.
Korvo gets his ass kicked by a dad at Jesse and Yumyulack's school.

eps.t: The Solar Opposites Do an Intervention
eps.o: The gang comes together to expose hard truths to one of their celebrity friends.
The Solars have a What If?! Device which can show them what their lives would be like if they made different choices.
For the small people shrunk down by Yumyulack, an adventure awaits in the back yard!
Yumyulack finds out some unsavory news about his mission role.
